description: Recommend a model tier (cheap, mid or premium) for a coding request before any work starts. Combines otito's deterministic repository half (AX, containment, top-severity risk paths) with a System One model's calibrated read of the request (specificity, blast radius, novelty). The model is called only when TYPESAFE_API_KEY is set in this server's environment and offline is not true; otherwise the read is a labelled offline estimate, and model.source says which. Advisory: it recommends a tier and never feeds review_gate or review_verdict. Pass host to map the tier to that host's model id.

host.description: Optional host whose model map resolves the tier to a model id (built in: claude-code; add others in .otito/model-route.json).

includeMarkdown.description: Return a compact human-readable markdown report instead of the full JSON. Defaults to false.

offline.description: Never call the model, even when a key is set. Defaults to false.

path.description: Repository path. Defaults to current working directory.

query.description: Plain-English change request to route, e.g. "fix the typo in the README".

top.description: Number of impact files to consider. Defaults to 8.

name: model_route
title: Model Route
